summary: Air evacuation of 85 fifth-graders and 14 chaperones stranded at the Cal-Wood Outdoor Education Center after a main road washed out
location: Cal-Wood Outdoor Education Center near Jamestown
notes: Seven helicopters (four Blackhawks) deployed by the National Guard; flown to Boulder Municipal Airport on Saturday 2013-09-14 around 2 p.m. MDT, then bused back to Fireside Elementary in Louisville. Source: Weather.com/NBC report.
